title: Close-out writes the UNRELEASED line itself, and the step sits first in close-out.md
description: Fabio 2026-10-28: agents were not adding user-facing changes to docs/releases/UNRELEASED.md at close-out (MPI-1320 missed it). Cause: the step sat at line 79 of a 182-line close-out.md that agents read with head -60/-80, and it was a Your call line written only on a yes that archived sessions never got. Fix: move the release-notes step to the top and make it write-then-report.
